parsed.rationale: Four separate packages — Playlist, Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit — each declare an unnamed extension on URLSession in unrelated files. The Core package already contains a dedicated URLSession+WebSession.swift, which is the natural canonical home for shared URLSession extensions. Consolidating all four extension declarations into Core's URLSession+WebSession.swift eliminates the name-collision risk across packages and ensures that all consumers depend on a single, auditable extension surface. No restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen) are set on any of the four records, so there is no fixture-protection concern.
